fixture.prepared: top-down F32 deterministic RGBA modular field
fixture.rank: top-down F32 deterministic per-row rank permutation
fixture.brightest: 1xheight F32 R values with other color lanes zero and alpha one
fixture.verification: fresh double render, immutable three inputs, finite full output, F32/RGBA8 hashes and probes

normative_domain: brightestTex.r is normalized to [0,1] and dimensions fit signed int32; negative zero is an explicit sign-erasure control

exclusions.contract: not native parity acceptance cases; these freeze why the exact profile cannot authorize generic round or out-of-range conversion
